tagline: A hands-on, role-based curriculum for engineers who build with AI — LLM apps, RAG, agents, and multi-agent systems, from first app to systems architect.
overview: This org covers **AI engineering** — *building with* the models: LLM application development, retrieval and RAG, agents and multi-agent systems, evaluation, guardrails, harness engineering, and production operations. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository (modules, lecture chapters, exercises, quizzes) and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.
highlights: 🤖 **Agentic track** of four rungs: Agentic AI Developer → Engineer → Senior → Systems Architect

focus.agentic-ai-developer: LLM fundamentals, prompting & structured output, tool calling, retrieval basics, first agent, shipping
focus.agentic-ai-engineer: Agent loop, frameworks, RAG & memory, multi-agent, evals, guardrails, production, harness engineering
focus.ai-eval-engineer: Trace instrumentation, trajectory & tool evals, LLM-as-judge, RAG evals, eval-gated CI/CD, online evals
focus.applied-ai-engineer: AI feature design, production prompting, RAG in product, orchestration, product agents, guardrails
focus.rag-engineer: Ingestion & chunking, embeddings, vector DBs & ANN tuning, learning-to-rank, hybrid retrieval, reranking
focus.senior-agentic-ai-engineer: Agent systems from an architecture, eval & observability infra, multi-agent at scale, reliability, cost
focus.agentic-systems-architect: When not to use an agent, orchestration & memory architecture, eval harnesses, security, durable execution
focus.forward-deployed-engineer: Customer discovery, integrating into enterprise stacks, evals on customer data, demo→production, field feedback loops
focus.agent-platform-engineer: Internal agent platforms: harnesses, tool & MCP registries, sandboxing, permissions, shared evals & tracing, paved roads
focus.voice-agent-engineer: STT/TTS & speech-to-speech, latency & turn-taking, telephony/WebRTC, vision inputs, voice & multimodal evals
focus.ai-engineering-manager: Hiring & leveling AI roles, planning non-deterministic work, eval-driven delivery, vendor risk, teams that use coding agents

technologies.Coding-agent harnesses: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Claude Agent SDK
technologies.Retrieval: pgvector, Chroma, Qdrant, BM25 hybrid search, reranking
technologies.Observability & evals: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, LangSmith, Phoenix, Ragas, Inspect
technologies.Safety & governance: OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act
